summary: Ask ten teachers, Would you like all your student work and their metadata in one file or in two different files? See what the say. Ohh yeah also ask the teachers if they think they should be able to read said file(s) . Again see what they say.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Ask ten teachers, Would you like all your student work and their metadata in one file or in two different files? See what the say.

Ohh yeah also ask the teachers if they think they should be able to read said file(s) . Again see what they say.
